message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts. The case: Jiang Mou used a "meeting" scheme to attract public deposits, i.e., illegal collection of public funds, disrupting financial order. This is classic "非法吸收公众存款". The facts: he collected from 18 victims 1,087,700 yuan. He used funds for payments, loans, etc. He voluntarily surrendered. So charge: 非法吸收公众存款. Possibly also "集资诈骗"? The list includes "集资诈骗". However the description says "变相吸收公众存款" which is illegal public deposit. In Chinese criminal law, illegal public deposit is a crime separate from "集资诈骗". The examples earlier: first example about "非法吸收公众存款" used that label. So answer: [罪名]非法吸收公众存款<eoa>. No other charges. So final answer JSON.
